channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Astario
item.description: Astario is a universe in which you can build functional ships and orbital stations with automated factories. Collect materials, craft new blocks, and expand into the universe. Nothing is ever truly static, ships, stations, asteroids, planets, everything follows the laws of orbital motion.

item.title: Double Whammy
item.description: Run a guitar shop by day. Smash monsters by night. 🎸

item.title: Food Devils
item.description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

item.title: No Asteroids
item.description: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig.

item.title: PC Store Together
item.description: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

item.title: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
item.description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

item.title: SHRED A BILLION
item.description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!

item.title: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga - Hold the Line
item.description: Fight through 15 escalating defense battles in this strategy RPG expansion. Capture valuable nodes, launch daring counterattacks, recruit familiar heroes, strengthen your squads, earn army-wide bonuses between chapters, and push your army command skills to new heights.

item.title: Your party died again
item.description: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

item.title: A Thousand Cloys
item.description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

item.title: AI War 2
item.description: The most devious and acclaimed artificial intelligence in strategy gaming is better than ever. A grand strategy/RTS hybrid that reverses many conventions of both genres. Take territory without attracting attention, build your empire with care, and adapt to an ever-evolving galactic battleground.

item.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
item.description: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

item.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
item.description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

item.title: Halloween: The Game
item.description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

item.title: Internet Cafe 98
item.description: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.

item.title: Little Kitty, Big City
item.description: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends with stray animals, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

item.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Ashes and Ascension
item.description: Lead your Mercenary Company through a new 18-mission campaign, 13 new 'Mechs, new Inner Sphere OmniMechs, variants, weapons, ground units, and more. As the Inner Sphere goes on the offensive and takes the fight to the Clans.

item.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
item.description: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

item.title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Space Program
item.description: Bring your glorious republics to the final frontier with a space program packed with dedicated technologies, buildings, vehicles, and mechanics that unlock the stars.
